subject: MAP kickoff: Orion Health - Mutual Action Plan draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Orion Health - Mutual Action Plan draft

Hi Jordan -

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. As discussed, I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to help align milestones, owners, and a target close window. Attached is a one-page draft for review.

High-level recommended milestones (initial draft):
- Week 0: MAP kickoff + stakeholder alignment - Owner: Orion (Jordan) / Redwood (Marissa) - Deliverable: confirmed stakeholders, kickoff minutes
- Week 1-3: Technical validation & eval access - Owner: Orion (Cloud/Infra) / Redwood SE (Aditya) - Deliverable: evaluation environment, sample workload tests
- Week 4-6: Pilot (performance & cost validation) - Owner: Orion product engineering / Redwood ops - Deliverable: pilot report, recommended config
- Week 7-8: Procurement & contract finalization - Owner: Orion procurement / Redwood sales - Deliverable: signed order form
- Week 9: Production cutover plan & go/no-go - Owner: Orion Ops / Redwood CS (Jonas) - Deliverable: cutover playbook

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (accelerated): 8 weeks - target close by 2026-09-02
- Option B (recommended): 12 weeks - target close by 2026-10-07 (allows extra procurement buffer)

Can you confirm:
1) Primary stakeholders we should loop into the MAP (names + emails)
2) Preferred timeline option (8w vs 12w) and target close date
3) If you want a short 30-min MAP kickoff next week to walk through milestones and risks - propose Tue/Thu 10-12 PT or Wed 2-4 PT

I attached the draft MAP (MAP-draft-v1.pdf). If you prefer, I can push an updated draft after you confirm stakeholders and timeline.

Thanks - looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa - great summary and clear draft. Quick notes from our side after syncing with the team:

Stakeholders to include in the MAP:
- Maya Singh, CFO - maya.singh@orionhealth.com
- Liam O'Connor, Head of Cloud Ops - liam.oconnor@orionhealth.com

I can do a 30-min kickoff next week - Wed 2:00 PM PT works for me. Please include the updated MAP prior to the call.

- Jordan
